Real on-device AI. First use downloads the model once (~40MB). Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a photo (JPG, PNG or WebP) by clicking the drop zone or dragging the file in.
  2. Click “Remove background”. On first use the AI model downloads once (~40MB) — later runs are instant.
  3. Watch the progress bar while the AI separates your subject from the background.
  4. Preview the transparent result side-by-side with the original, then download it as a PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is my photo uploaded to a server?

No. The AI model runs entirely in your browser using WebAssembly. Your image never leaves your device.

Why does the first use take longer?

The background-removal AI model (~40MB) is downloaded from a CDN the first time you use the tool. It is then cached by your browser, so later uses start immediately.

What output format do I get?

A PNG with a transparent background, ideal for product photos, profile pictures, thumbnails and design work.
